response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished full-stack and web developer with broad experience, but is fundamentally misaligned with this role. He lacks native-level Japanese proficiency (a hard requirement), has no demonstrated experience in embedded networking, LAN switches, or security technologies like MACsec or 802.1X, and shows no Linux kernel investigation or modification experience. His C experience is limited to a brief 7-month stint in 2014–2015, far from the strong C/UNIX proficiency required.
strengths: Long, varied software engineering career (15+ years) with strong Linux and testing culture
Some low-level and systems experience (DLang low-latency services, C/C++ at National Instruments, hardware work with robotic arms)
Strong open-source contributions and knowledge-sharing track record
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency, which is a strict requirement for the role
No embedded networking, switch, or security-protocol experience (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP, NETCONF)
Minimal recent C experience and no Linux kernel source investigation or modification background

key_factors.factor: Weak C/UNIX and Linux kernel background
